caption: Each ring narrows the rerun for the GST change: from all 500 tests, to the 80-test regression suite, to the 12 tests that touch invoice calculation. The innermost ring is the one that must run for this change.

spec.aria: Three nested sets: all 500 tests containing login, GST invoice and refund; the 80-test regression suite containing GST invoice and refund; and the 12 impact-selected tests containing only GST invoice.
